recall_at_k.method: Selected pre-expansion top-5 children; binary nonempty gold-span overlap proxy; labels are NOT exhaustive semantic relevance. Macro-average answerable cases; precision divides by K, misses zero.

precision_at_k.method: Selected pre-expansion top-5 children; binary nonempty gold-span overlap proxy; labels are NOT exhaustive semantic relevance. Macro-average answerable cases; precision divides by K, misses zero.

hit_rate_at_k.method: Selected pre-expansion top-5 children; binary nonempty gold-span overlap proxy; labels are NOT exhaustive semantic relevance. Macro-average answerable cases; precision divides by K, misses zero.

mrr_at_k.method: Selected pre-expansion top-5 children; binary nonempty gold-span overlap proxy; labels are NOT exhaustive semantic relevance. Macro-average answerable cases; precision divides by K, misses zero.

ndcg_at_k.method: Selected pre-expansion top-5 children; binary nonempty gold-span overlap proxy; labels are NOT exhaustive semantic relevance. Macro-average answerable cases; precision divides by K, misses zero.

annotated_char_recall.method: Union of actual supplied source spans; average gold spans per answer then macro-average answerable cases.

full_evidence_recall.method: Union of actual supplied source spans; average gold spans per answer then macro-average answerable cases.

answer_correctness.method: Expected-point correctness, 0/1/2 normalized, macro-average. Extra claim errors are separate; not overall accuracy. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

answer_completeness.method: Fraction of expected points attempted, regardless of truth; macro-average. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

fully_correct_points.method: Fraction of expected points fully correct (2), macro-average. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

faithfulness.method: Fraction of inventoried factual claims supported by supplied evidence, macro-average over claim-bearing answers. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

answer_relevance.method: LLM 0 off-topic / 1 partly responsive or extraneous / 2 directly responsive, normalized macro-average. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

citation_support.method: Fraction of assessed claim-citation pairs with semantic support, macro-average over cited answers. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

citation_coverage.method: Fraction of factual claims with at least one supporting inline citation, macro-average over claim-bearing answers. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

appropriate_abstention.method: Appropriate explicit refusal without invented specifics on unanswerable cases. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

incorrect_abstention.method: Unjustified refusal on answerable cases despite supplied evidence; separate from retrieval-caused refusals. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

answerable_refusal.method: Any full/partial refusal on answerable cases, including missing retrieved evidence. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

strict_pass_rate.method: All points correct, claims supported and cited, relevant, correct refusal behavior; generation errors fail. LLM assessment, not ground truth.

first_delta_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95.

total_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95.

generation_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95.

generation_first_delta_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95.

retrieval_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95.

embedding_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95.

rerank_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95.

packing_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95.

search_fusion_seconds.reason: Production service exposes total retrieval, embedding, rerank and packing; search/fusion not independently timed.

reliability.method: All planned RAG requests; SDK retries disabled, partial answers do not succeed.

judge_reliability.method: No automatic repair/retry. Invalid review remains pending; protocol defines judgment stages.

judge_seconds.method: All completed review attempts, including pending/errors; median P50, nearest-rank P95; excludes worker queue wait.

ingestion.method: Provider-reported totals for 43/43 calls; missing failed-call usage excluded, not zero billed cost.

query_embedding.method: Provider-reported totals for 24/24 calls; missing failed-call usage excluded, not zero billed cost.

generation.method: Provider-reported totals for 24/24 calls; missing failed-call usage excluded, not zero billed cost.

judge.method: Provider-reported totals for 72/72 calls; missing failed-call usage excluded, not zero billed cost.

cost.reason: Provider responses do not expose billed dollars; no inferred price substituted.

evidence_tokens.method: Exact formatted supplied evidence tokens including metadata.

concurrency_throughput.method: Sequential RAG batch including logging, excluding initialization, ingestion and judge; not load capacity.
